description: A contemporary retelling where the widow’s son is drawn into an isolated renovation mansion run by a hidden troll, escapes with the help of a cursed black horse, and uses salvaged gear, improvised “magic” objects, and a double life as a mocked garden worker to save a ruthless tycoon-king’s estate and win freedom, love, and power.
tone: Dark modern fairy tale, suspenseful and gritty with moments of wonder and hard-won tenderness
summary: A poor widow’s son flees a troll’s modern hideout and secretly becomes the armored rider who saves a powerful tycoon’s household.
